coverage_notes: Program shapes are composed only from behaviour anchored by the 42 manual examples and the full-row port trace.
assert_rows gives the number of trailing rows each step asserts; intermediate echo rows are deliberately unchecked (suffix rule).
SIGN, the 00 key and fractional entries longer than DP are not oracle-anchored and are excluded from this corpus.
Add/subtract chains ending in '=' never use rounding FL (no manual example anchors FL totals); memory blocks run at 5/4 as in their manual sources; overflow recovery runs at IN with DP=8 (14-3).
